   "id": "d94d3c21",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "(Tutorial_Get_secondary_structure)=\n",
    "# Get secondary structure\n",
    "\n",
    "*Assigning secondary structure per residue using DSSP rules.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The function {func}`molsysmt.structure.get_secondary_structure` assigns secondary structure categories (such as $\\alpha$-helices, $\\beta$-strands, and coils) to amino acid residues across single structures or simulation trajectories using the DSSP algorithm.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow this link for a detailed description of the input arguments, raised errors, and returned objects of this function: {func}`molsysmt.structure.get_secondary_structure`.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "46af81ca",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "Let's show how to assign 3-state secondary structure categories for TcTIM (PDB ID: 1TCD):\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "e2a8fa0c",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:44.853152Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:44.852720Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:46.032921Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:46.031890Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "ce984c6b",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:46.035863Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:46.035450Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:51.718017Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:51.716915Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['TcTIM']['1tcd.h5msm'])\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "f47c3932",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    ":::{note} Demo Systems Catalog\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "This tutorial uses demonstration datasets provided by MolSysMT. To explore the full catalog of bundled systems, forms, and file paths, visit the {ref}`Demo Systems <user-foundations-entrance-demo-systems>` guide.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "71283b17",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "By default, {func}`molsysmt.structure.get_secondary_structure` uses the simplified 3-state classification: `'H'` (helix), `'E'` (extended strand), and `'C'` (coil/loop):\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "0c01ef45",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:51.721523Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:51.721000Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:52.034627Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:52.033280Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Secondary structure array shape: (1, 662)\n",
      "First 25 residue assignments: ['C' 'C' 'C' 'C' 'E' 'E' 'E' 'E' 'E' 'C' 'C' 'E' 'C' 'C' 'C' 'H' 'H' 'H'\n",
      " 'H' 'H' 'H' 'H' 'H' 'H' 'H']\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ss_3state = msm.structure.get_secondary_structure(molsys, simplified=True)\n",
    "print('Secondary structure array shape:', ss_3state.shape)\n",
    "print('First 25 residue assignments:', ss_3state[0, :25])\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4bc6ce11",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Full 8-state DSSP assignment\n",
    "\n",
    "Setting `simplified=False` returns the detailed 8-category DSSP classification (`'H'`, `'B'`, `'E'`, `'G'`, `'I'`, `'T'`, `'S'`, `' '`):\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "349e2a95",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:52.037837Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:52.037135Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:52.108120Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:52.107289Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "First 25 residues in 8-state classification: [' ' ' ' ' ' ' ' 'E' 'E' 'E' 'E' 'E' ' ' ' ' 'B' ' ' ' ' ' ' 'H' 'H' 'H'\n",
      " 'H' 'H' 'H' 'H' 'H' 'H' 'H']\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ss_8state = msm.structure.get_secondary_structure(molsys, simplified=False)\n",
    "print('First 25 residues in 8-state classification:', ss_8state[0, :25])\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "83d846c4",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Visualizing secondary structure composition\n",
    "\n",
    "We plot the overall secondary structure composition across the protein:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "fbe37cad",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:36:52.122510Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:36:52.122069Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:36:52.468306Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:36:52.467339Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 700x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "unique_states, counts = np.unique(ss_3state[0], return_counts=True)\n",
    "state_labels = {'H': 'α-Helix', 'E': 'β-Strand', 'C': 'Coil/Loop', 'NA': 'Non-protein'}\n",
    "labels = [state_labels.get(s, s) for s in unique_states]\n",
    "colors = {'H': '#e74c3c', 'E': '#3498db', 'C': '#95a5a6', 'NA': '#bdc3c7'}\n",
    "bar_colors = [colors.get(s, '#7f8c8d') for s in unique_states]\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(7, 4))\n",
    "plt.bar(labels, counts, color=bar_colors, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85, width=0.5)\n",
    "plt.ylabel('Residue Count')\n",
    "plt.title('Secondary Structure Composition in TcTIM')\n",
    "plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
